home.title: Grand Prior's Palace
home.description: Rent the representative rooms and garden of the Grand Prior's Palace in Prague's Lesser Town for conferences, receptions, concerts and weddings.

prostory.title: Spaces
prostory.description: Halls, salons and the garden of the Grand Prior's Palace for rent: photographs, capacities and floor plans.
prostory.lead: We rent the representative rooms of the palace and the garden behind the Lennon Wall for conferences, receptions, concerts and weddings. The ground floor and the first floor each have their own preparation room for catering.

ke-stazeni.lead: Floor plans and the garden layout for planning your event.

kontakt.title: Contact
kontakt.description: Contact for renting the rooms of the Grand Prior's Palace in Prague's Lesser Town.

exterier.title: Exterior and garden
exterier.lead: The palace with its courtyard, and the garden behind the Lennon Wall, where Ludwig van Beethoven composed under the great plane tree during his stay in Prague. The garden is entered from the Lennon Wall, and three doors open onto it from the sala terrena.

kocarovna.title: Coach Room
kocarovna.lead: A vaulted hall on the ground floor of the palace. The ground floor also has the sala terrena, opening onto the garden, and a preparation room for catering.

schodiste.title: Staircase
schodiste.lead: The palace's monumental three-flight staircase, with putti carrying lamps from the workshop of Matthias Bernhard Braun.

vez.title: Tower Room
vez.lead: A Gothic room in the tower with a rib vault and an oriel window.

jidelna.title: Grand Prior's Dining Room
jidelna.lead: A smaller dining room on the first floor for seated dinners.

cerveny-salon.title: Red Saloon
cerveny-salon.lead: A saloon on the first floor, between the Knights' Hall and the Grand Prior's Dining Room.

rytirsky-sal.title: Knights' Hall
rytirsky-sal.lead: The largest hall of the palace, on the first floor, with a tiled stove, a marble fireplace and parquet floors.

ui.siteFullSub: Seat of the Grand Priory of Bohemia of the Sovereign Military Hospitaller Order of St. John of Jerusalem of Rhodes and of Malta
ui.heroLead: Welcome to the Grand Prior's Palace and its garden behind the Lennon Wall, in one of the most romantic corners of Prague. The palace has been the seat of the Grand Priory of Bohemia of the Order of Malta, formerly known as the Knights of St John, for over 850 years.
ui.rentText: Conferences, receptions, concerts and weddings. Prices are agreed according to the type of event.
ui.rentSubject: Renting rooms at the Grand Prior's Palace
ui.aboutText: For all kinds of events we rent out our representative rooms, where among other things Miloš Forman filmed his Amadeus, and the garden behind the Lennon Wall, where Ludwig van Beethoven composed under the great plane tree during his stay in Prague.
